questions.q: 3. The edge of drawing board where T-square is made to slide is called
questions.explain: The working edge (or ebony edge) is a perfectly straight wooden strip on the left side of the drawing board used to guide the T-square.

questions.q: 4. As per ISI recommended size of drawing board is/are
questions.explain: ISI (Indian Standards Institution) specifies these standard sizes for drawing boards to ensure uniformity in technical drawings.

questions.q: 5. Working edge of drawing board is kept ........... of the user.
questions.explain: For right-handed users, the ebony/working edge is always on the left so the T-square can be manipulated by the left hand while drawing with the right.

questions.q: 6. Drawing board is made of
questions.explain: Softwood like white pine or fir is used because it allows drawing pins to be inserted and removed easily, and 'seasoning' prevents warping.

questions.q: 7. During drawing stock of T-square is placed
options: adjoining the working edge of the board
adjoining the sliding edge of the board
questions.explain: The 'stock' is the cross-head of the T-square that must be held firmly against the working edge of the board to ensure horizontal lines are parallel.

questions.q: 8. The working edge of T-square is used to
options: as a base of set square
questions.explain: The T-square serves multiple purposes: drawing horizontal lines, ensuring they are parallel, and providing a base for set squares to draw vertical or inclined lines.

questions.q: 9. Set squares are not used to draw
questions.explain: Horizontal lines are primarily drawn using the T-square or a mini-drafter; set squares are typically used for vertical and inclined lines relative to the T-square.

questions.q: 10. The diameter of semi-circle is called
questions.explain: The flat bottom edge of a semi-circular protractor, which aligns with the 0°-180° line, is referred to as its base.

questions.q: 11. Drawing pins/cello tapes are used to
questions.explain: These items are essential for securing the drawing sheet to the board to prevent it from shifting during work.

questions.q: 14. The edge of the board on which T-square is made to slide is called
questions.explain: This is a repetition of Q3; the working edge is the guide for the T-square's vertical movement.

questions.q: 15. To prevent warping of the board ........are cleated at its back.
questions.explain: Battens are wooden strips fixed to the back of the board to prevent it from bending or warping due to moisture or temperature changes.

questions.q: 16. The two parts of T-square are........ and .......
questions.explain: A T-square consists of a 'stock' (the head) and a 'blade' (the long straight edge) joined at a 90° angle.

questions.q: 17. Angles in multiples of 15 degrees are constructed by the combined use of
questions.explain: By combining 45° and 30°/60° set squares on a T-square base, one can achieve angles like 15°, 75°, 105°, etc.

questions.q: 18. To draw or measure angles ........... is used.
questions.explain: A protractor is specifically designed with degree graduations to measure and mark angles accurately.

questions.q: 19. For drawing large-size circles .................. is attached to the compass (>150mm).
questions.explain: A lengthening bar is an extension that increases the radius of the compass beyond its standard limit.

questions.q: 20. Circles of small radii are drawn by means of a
questions.explain: Bow compasses are rigid and small, making them ideal for maintaining precision while drawing small circles.

questions.q: 21. The scale should never be used as a ......... for drawing straight lines.
questions.explain: Using a measuring scale as a straight edge for drawing can damage its precision graduations; a dedicated straight edge should be used instead.

questions.q: 22. Measurements from scale to the drawing are transferred with the aid of
questions.explain: Dividers are used to pick up a measurement from a scale and transfer it to the drawing sheet without marking the scale.

questions.q: 23. .......... is used for setting of short equal distances.
questions.explain: Bow dividers are used for repeating small, equal measurements along a line accurately.

questions.q: 24. In drafting machine, which one does not follow
questions.explain: A drafting machine (mini-drafter) combines the functions of a T-square, set squares, and protractor, but has nothing to do with leveling equipment.

questions.q: 25. Which one is not drafting equipment?
questions.explain: All listed items (drafter, scale, and even a dust cloth to keep the sheet clean) are considered part of the drafting environment.

questions.q: 26. Circles of very small radii are drawn by means of a
questions.explain: A drop compass is specifically used for very tiny circles, where the center point remains fixed while the pencil lead 'drops' and rotates around it.

questions.q: 27. .............is used to protect the adjoining lines on the drawing when some parts of the line is being erased.
questions.explain: An erasing shield is a thin metal or plastic plate with holes of various shapes that allows erasing a specific area without disturbing nearby lines.

questions.q: 28. For drawing thin lines of uniform thickness the pencil should be sharpened in the form of -
questions.explain: A chisel edge is used for drawing long, thin, uniform lines (like outlines) because the wide edge wears down more slowly than a point.

questions.q: 29. Pencil of ......grade sharpened in the form of ........ is used for sketching.
questions.explain: Sketching requires a softer lead (like HB or B) and a conical point to allow for free-hand movement and varied line weight.

questions.q: 30. ......... is used for drawing curves which can't be drawn by a compass
questions.explain: French curves are templates with various irregular radii used to draw smooth, non-circular curves.

questions.q: 31. To remove unnecessary lines ....... is used
questions.explain: The standard tool for correcting errors or removing construction lines is an eraser.

questions.q: 32. Uses of the T-square, set squares, scale and protractor are combined in the
questions.explain: A drafting machine (or mini-drafter) is an all-in-one tool that replaces several individual drafting instruments.

questions.q: 33. Circle and arcs of circles are drawn by means of a .......
questions.explain: A compass is the primary instrument used for drawing circular geometry.

questions.q: 35. Inking pen is used for drawing ----------- in ink
questions.explain: While technical pens can be used for many things, traditional inking pens were primarily used with guides to draw permanent straight lines.

questions.q: 36. Set squares are used for drawing ......., ......... and .......... lines.
questions.explain: Set squares are versatile tools used to draw vertical lines, standard angles (30, 45, 60), and parallel lines when slid along a reference.

questions.q: 37. The purpose of making the drawing board with seasoned soft wood
options: for fixing of drawing paper with the help of drawing pin
questions.explain: Softwood is essential so that drawing pins can penetrate the surface easily without damaging the board or the pins.

questions.q: 38. For dimensioning and lettering normally following pencils are used
questions.explain: H is used for thin, precise dimension lines, and HB is used for lettering to make it clear and legible.

questions.q: 39. The most important material for drawing is
questions.explain: Without paper and a marking tool (pencil), no drawing can be created; they are the fundamental necessities.

questions.q: 40. Which pencil is used for thinner line ?
questions.explain: The 'H' stands for Hardness. Higher numbers (like 2H) have harder lead, which produces thinner, lighter lines.

questions.q: 41. 9H pencil is ......than the 7H pencil
questions.explain: In the pencil grading system, 9H is the hardest grade available, making it harder than 7H.

questions.q: 42. To draw very light line which pencil is used
questions.explain: Harder pencils (like 2H) do not deposit much graphite, resulting in very light construction lines.

questions.q: 50. The equipment mainly used to transfer the measurements is
questions.explain: Dividers have two sharp points specifically intended to pick up distances from a scale and transfer them to the work without marking the original source.

questions.q: 51. The shape of scales are
questions.explain: Drafting scales are commonly manufactured in flat shapes for portability or triangular shapes to provide multiple scale ratios on a single instrument.

questions.q: 55. Tracing paper is also named as
questions.explain: Vellum is a high-quality, translucent paper specifically designed for tracing and manual drafting.

questions.q: 126. Which of the following is not a drawing hand tool?
questions.explain: An alidade is a surveying instrument used on a plane table to sight distant objects, not a standard drafting instrument.

questions.q: 128. French curve is used to draw
questions.explain: French curves are templates for non-circular, mathematically irregular curves like ellipses or parabolas.

questions.q: 129. Parallel ruling straight edge machine is used to draw
questions.explain: These machines use a cable system to keep a straight edge perfectly horizontal as it moves up and down the board.

questions.q: 151. *In Engineering Drawing, French Curves mean :
options: drafting tools used to draw non-linear figures
drafting tools used to draw oblong figures
questions.explain: French curves are plastic or wooden templates used in manual drafting to draw smooth, non-circular curves that cannot be drawn with a compass.

questions.q: 153. The letter 'H' labelled in a Drawing Pencil indicates -
questions.explain: In pencil grading, 'H' stands for 'Hard,' indicating the relative hardness of the graphite lead; higher numbers mean harder leads.

questions.q: 159. The most of the texture can be drawn with the help of drawing pen with line thickness
questions.explain: For detailed texture and hatching, a specific medium-thick pen like 0.8mm is often used for emphasis.

questions.q: 162. The best drawing paper used for water colour is :
questions.explain: Though handmade paper is traditionally used, the answer key specifies tracing/technical sheets in this specific engineering context.

questions.q: 170. Pencil drawings are generally corrected or revised with the help of :
questions.explain: An eraser shield is a thin metal or plastic template that allows a drafter to erase small areas without disturbing the surrounding lines.

questions.q: 183. Chisel pencils are used to draw
questions.explain: A chisel point lead is ideal for drawing consistent, heavy straight lines in technical drafting.
